_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for integrations. Read at runtime by the seed backend (backend/integrations) to drive routes + the Settings UI, and at plan time by clarity-api (SeedForkService.readSeedFile) to ground generation. Each entry describes WHAT credentials an app needs and HOW the user obtains each one (per-field howToObtain). authKind drives the connect flow: 'apikey'/'basic' = save-and-use; 'byo-oauth' = save client creds then run the user's own OAuth; 'webhook' = save a URL. status 'available' = curated/tested here; 'generated' = produced on demand by the reasoning flow for a not-yet-curated integration.

integrations.name: Gmail
integrations.summary: Read, organize, and act on the user's Gmail (triage, labels, archive/trash).

credentialFields.label: Client ID
credentialFields.help: Your Google OAuth 2.0 Web-application Client ID (ends in .apps.googleusercontent.com).

howToObtain.step: Open the Google Cloud Console and create or select a project.
Enable the Gmail API for that project.
Configure the OAuth consent screen (User type: External) and add YOUR OWN email under 'Test users'.
Go to Credentials → Create credentials → OAuth client ID → Application type: Web application.
Under 'Authorized redirect URIs', add the exact Redirect URI shown above this form, then click Create.
howToObtain.detail: It must match exactly, including https and no trailing slash.

howToObtain.step: Copy the 'Client ID' value and paste it here.

credentialFields.label: Client secret
credentialFields.help: The client secret created alongside the Client ID above.

howToObtain.step: On the same OAuth client you just created, copy the 'Client secret' value.
Paste it here. You can retrieve it again anytime from the Credentials page.

setupGuide.detail: Console → New Project (or pick an existing one).
APIs & Services → Library → Gmail API → Enable.

setupGuide.step: Set up the OAuth consent screen
setupGuide.detail: User type External; add your own email under Test users so you can connect before Google verification.
Credentials → Create credentials → OAuth client ID → Web application.
Paste the Redirect URI shown above into 'Authorized redirect URIs' — it must match exactly.

setupGuide.step: Paste Client ID + Client secret below, then click Connect
setupGuide.detail: You'll be sent to Google to grant access; tokens are stored encrypted and used by this app on your behalf.

integrations.name: OpenAI
integrations.summary: Use the user's own OpenAI account for model calls (chat, embeddings).

credentialFields.label: API key
credentialFields.help: An OpenAI API key (starts with 'sk-'). Billed to your own OpenAI account.

howToObtain.step: Sign in to the OpenAI platform.
Click 'Create new secret key', give it a name, and create it.
Copy the key now (it's shown only once) and paste it here.

setupGuide.detail: API keys → Create new secret key.

setupGuide.step: Paste the key below and Save
setupGuide.detail: Stored encrypted; used for this app's model calls on your account.
